treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Republic of Lithuania for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income and on Capital (1996; modified by MLI)
eif_quote: Income Tax Conventions Implementation Act, 1997, Part 2: "[Note: Convention in force December 12, 1997, see Canada Gazette Part I, Volume 132, page 157.]" | Treaty-accord: "Entry into Force 12 December 1997"
source_title: Income Tax Conventions Implementation Act, 1997 (S.C. 1997, c. 38), Schedule 2 - Canada-Lithuania Convention (Justice Laws consolidated text)

rates.quote: (a) except in the case of dividends paid by a non-resident-owned investment corporation that is a resident of Canada, 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which controls directly at least 25 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividends;
(b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2 However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if a resident of the other Contracting State is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2 However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if a resident of the other Contracting State is the beneficial owner of the royalties the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: 1 Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude; having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement. [Canada and Lithuania both notified Art. 28(3) of the Convention as an existing provision described in MLI Art. 7(2)]

notes: Art. 30(a): effective for tax withheld at source on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (EIF 1997-12-12 -> 1998-01-01). Dividend 5% tier: company that "controls directly at least 25 per cent of the voting power" (voting-power test recorded as ownership_threshold 25); excludes dividends paid by a Canadian non-resident-owned investment corporation. MLI art. 8 does not apply (Lithuania reserved the entirety of Art. 8 under Art. 8(3)(a)). Art. 12(7) MFN: if Lithuania later exempts copyright or patent/know-how royalties in a treaty with an OECD member, that exemption automatically applies - no official notice found; not modelled. Not modelled: Art. 11(3) exemptions (interest paid to governments, Bank of Canada/Bank of Lithuania, EDC and similar, guaranteed loans, credit sales of merchandise/equipment between unrelated enterprises, late-payment penalty interest); Art. 10(6) branch tax 5%.
